nodes.label: Babai's Nearest Plane algorithm (Alg. 1)
nodes.rationale: Succeeds iff the error lies in P_1/2(B*); success probability with respect to LWE parameter generation.

nodes.label: CLWE continuous-Gaussian success model (erf product)
nodes.rationale: Replaces the discrete LWE error by a spherical continuous Gaussian so the success probability factorises as prod erf(d_i||b*_i||sqrt(pi)/2s); LP claim without proof that it is close.

nodes.label: Fixed-norm uniform-sphere success lower bound
nodes.rationale: Since e/||e|| is uniform, a sphere probability with R_m set so Pr(||e||>R_m) is negligible lower-bounds success; R = expected error length is called a rough estimate, so sampling the error distribution is preferred.

nodes.label: GNR pruned enumeration for BDD (Alg. 4)
nodes.rationale: Depth-first search with bounding function R1<=...<=Rm; cost T_redu + T_node*N/p_succ; method of choice for general BDD.

nodes.label: Linear bounding function R_k = sqrt(k/m) R_m
nodes.norm_label: linear bounding function r_k = sqrt(k/m) r_m
nodes.rationale: Linear pruning beats even randomized NP for LWE independently of reduction-time estimates.

nodes.label: NearestPlanes viewed as pruned enumeration
nodes.rationale: NP keeps nodes with bounded Gram-Schmidt coordinates while GNR keeps bounded projections; the NP tree is a subset of some GNR tree (secondary pruning).
